component_inference.failure_example: Nine .button--* sibling modifiers mix color, size, layout, and specialized-component axes under one prefix

notes: No semantic CSS custom property definitions — yet GSS scored this site higher than bungee-pro
Palette richness (76 unique hexes) and saturation separation appear to help algorithmic mapping more than semantic variable declarations do
Hand-bound brand color #c12126 collides with intent.danger on same hex; GSS resolved by picking the darker hover-red #9b090d for intent.danger
GSS bound accent.primary to the gold #f3ca3e (the site's --primary token) rather than the dominant brand red — disagrees with human reading
